M-CLIP-SERVICE.Purpose: Read-only local and ancestor clip queries over the published geometry snapshot.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Local child clip and ancestor clip queries over WidgetGeometrySnapshot.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Native GUI execution: WidgetRenderer owns standard child clips; concrete widgets own their specialized native child contexts.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Rounded, arbitrary-path or offscreen subtree clipping.

Requirements.REQ-001: Published non-visible Overflow restricts descendants to the local padding box; visible Overflow admits descendants without a clip.
Requirements.REQ-002: ClipRegion uses the published owner World matrix before the child-space transform; containment uses TransformService to map the point into owner-local coordinates.
Requirements.REQ-003: Only ancestors clip a widget's own hit surface; children and hit testing use the same owner-local clip rectangles.
Requirements.REQ-004: Nested clip intersections preserve the ordered list of ancestor regions rather than approximating their intersection by one screen bounding box.

Inputs.IN-002: Pointer position in screen coordinates for visibility checks.

Outputs.OUT-001: Owner-local child clip bounds, ancestor ClipRegions and point-containment results.
